generation_or_recording_prompt: Produce original audio for Dave's & Enemies, a smooth cartoon desert action adventure. Asset snd_voice_dave_2: Dave dialogue blip take 2. Record an original adult human performer, or synthesize a human-like formant murmur, warm, grounded and firm with no imitation of an existing character or actor. Make exactly one slightly firmer low-mid closed-mouth hum with a soft breath release. Preserve a compact chest/nasal body with no click at either edge, no reverb and no intelligible syllable or word. The quoted phonetic description is an articulation direction, not a word to speak. Match the other Dave takes in perceived level and baseline register; runtime supplies only restrained +/-6% pitch variation. Deliver 1 distinct take, each 0.08 seconds long including decay. This is a single event, not a loop; do not add a second event or a montage. No intelligible words, dialogue sentences, music, background ambience or unrelated actions. Use original recordings or synthesis; do not sample reference games, copy recognizable character voices, or imitate a named performer. Export WAV, signed PCM 16-bit, 44.1 kHz, mono, peak no higher than -1 dBFS. Judge short sounds by peak and perceived loudness; do not force an integrated LUFS target. No leading dead air; preserve designed decay and 2-5 ms click-free edge envelopes.
